constraints: Quad-core Cortex-A76 at 2.4 GHz; no dedicated NPU, so larger models rely on NEON-accelerated CPU inference.
ram_bytes and storage_bytes reflect the minimum shipped 8 GB RAM / 64 GB microSD configuration; higher-RAM SKUs exist.
storage_bytes represents removable microSD/NVMe (via M.2 HAT) capacity, not onboard flash.
